## Change

What problem does this solve? Link the discussion issue for a substantial new skill.

## Validation

Describe the checks and realistic usage examples you tried, and their outcomes.

## Access and dependencies

List added or changed commands, downloads, dependencies, accounts, permissions,
network destinations, and side effects. Write "None" when none changed.

## Review

- [ ] I ran the repository checks described in CONTRIBUTING.md.
- [ ] Instructions, examples, and referenced files match the proposed behavior.
- [ ] I identified any third-party material and preserved required notices.
- [ ] This change contains no credentials, private data, or personal machine paths.
